A '''mind prison''' that kept the consciousness of an unidentified [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Unidentified Rakatan prisoner|prisoner]], was one of several [[Mind prison]]s survived long after the fall of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. 

==History==
At some point, [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lurze Kesh]] acquired the mind prison and sold it to [[Motta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
He hired [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to serve as courier, with one warning: never to open the box. Kesh did not say what would happen if he did, though, and Revan's curiosity overcame his caution, trapping him in the [[Mind prison|prison]]. Two others had also become trapped there in the last month, but they had already gone mad and run off into the white void. Revan met the prison's original occupant, a [[Unidentified Rakatan prisoner|Rakatan warrior]] who had been imprisoned for leading a rebellion. After all that time, the warrior could not even remember his own name, but still desired to escape, and so challenged Revan to the only contest that would be fair to both and applicable in a world where neither had a physical body: a game of riddles. After stumping the warrior, Revan was given leave to escape back into his own body. However the box worked, he was unable to activate it again.<ref name="KotOR" />

Revan then went on to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as planned and gave it to Motta at the local swoop track, and learned the history of the device from Motta, who was amused to see that Revan had opened it.<ref name="KotOR" />
{{Endgame}}
==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My, my, my&hellip; the contest is over already! Fair is fair, sentient&hellip; I go free.|translated=1|Rakata prisoner to Revan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
The mind prison of an [[unidentified Rakatan prisoner]] was the first [[mind prison]] to appear in Star Wars, introduced in [[BioWare]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], released in [[2003]], as a "mysterious box." The object is part of an optional courier mission given by [[Lurze Kesh]]; however, in order to unlock the courier mission, the player must first gain access to the secret compartment within the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]''. Furthermore, the choice to open the mysterious box is optional as well. Completion of either of the aforementioned missions does not affect the player's [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alignment.<ref name="KotOR" />

If the player loses the riddle game against the prisoner, the game ends. The player can also choose not to open the box and merely give it to Motta the Hutt, avoiding the dangers of the prison within.<ref name="KotOR" />
